saw_lines: Fashion buyers rarely respond to a season announcement. They want one piece, a clear size and a reason to order now.
So the sale is decided in the first line, where a buyer either finds their piece or keeps scrolling past.
Your 11 of 21 copy ads open on one season line. Write two or three new openers from the pieces customers pick and test each one against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 26 Nov 2026
points: 11 of 21 copy ads open on the same season line, so a buyer hunting one piece reads past it first. Write two or three new openers from pieces customers pick, and test each against this line with the ad unchanged.
One exact copy runs in 11 of 21 ads, so a repeat viewer meets the same words again. Keep the body copy but rewrite the opening line and swap the creative in each of those 11 ads.

None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so a first time buyer has no count to trust before they click. Collect one real figure, such as review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.

9 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage rather than the product the creative shows, so someone who clicked for one piece has to search the whole store again. Point each of those 9 ads to its matching product page.

ads_1: Fresh openers built on fashion pieces, tested against the season line
